decision_question: Does exact replay apply the same causal market tick to signal features, executable entry quotes, maker prices, stored position state, and executable exits?

defect.before: The research harness derived a causal per-condition tick for paired-book features, but taker entry sizing, maker resting prices, stored position tick state, and settlement-basis sell limits still used metadata or the static 0.01 default. Cached live-replay also used the static 0.01 default for entry sizing and maker prices.
defect.risk: After a causal 0.01-to-0.001 transition, replay could round a visible 0.971 ask to a 0.98 FOK ceiling, reduce the budgeted share count, change the fee-aware edge decision, and round an executable 0.029 sell limit down to 0.02. That is an execution-parity defect even when signal features are causal.

repair_contract.condition_state: Initialize from a valid causal Gamma minimum_tick_size or 0.01, then persist 0.001 per condition after a replayed positive top bid or ask crosses below 0.04 or above 0.96.
repair_contract.taker_entry: Pass the causal condition tick into visible-depth budget sizing and the FOK worst-price ceiling.
repair_contract.maker_entry: Use the same causal condition tick for the post-only resting price in preflight, sizing, and order construction.
repair_contract.position_state: Store the causal decision-time tick in the simulated position rather than rereading static metadata.
repair_contract.exits: Use the latest persistent causal condition tick for exact opposite-leg buys and settlement-basis sells, including transitions that occur after entry.
repair_contract.cached_live_replay: Maintain the same persistent per-condition causal tick state and use it in entry quote construction.

fee_and_order_contract_audit.rounding: five decimal places; values that round below 0.00001 become zero
fee_and_order_contract_audit.fok_semantics: visible-depth book walk rejects any quantity not fully executable at or inside the submitted limit after the latency interval
fee_and_order_contract_audit.market_order_representation: a market buy is modeled as a marketable limit with an explicit FOK ceiling
fee_and_order_contract_audit.multi_level_fee_approximation: Replay applies the fee once at aggregate VWAP. Because p*(1-p) is concave, this is at least the size-weighted per-level fee before rounding. Aggregate L2 cannot reconstruct how size at one price was split across maker matches, so match-level five-decimal rounding remains an explicit exact-replay limitation.

deployed_measurement_v7.scoring_requirement: v7 retains the reproduction-hardened scorer hash from v6 and may score the sealed block.
deployed_measurement_v7.exact_replay_requirement: Any post-two-block exact replay must use v7 or a later binary with the pinned harness, live-replay, sizing, fee, fill-model, and scorer hashes.

validation.red_test: PASS: the entry and cached-replay tests initially failed to compile because causal tick state was not exposed; the post-entry transition test then reproduced the stale exit limit as 0.02 instead of 0.029.
validation.cargo_test: PASS: 504 passed (453 library + 51 binary), 0 failed; doc-tests 0
validation.cargo_clippy: PASS: all targets with warnings denied after allowing the two documented pre-existing unrelated lints

external_sources.title: Polymarket Orders Overview
external_sources.use: All orders are limit orders under the hood; FOK requires the entire order to execute immediately, and order prices must respect the market tick.

external_sources.title: Polymarket Fees
external_sources.use: Crypto takers use fee rate 0.07, makers pay zero, the binary fee curve is applied at match time, and fees use five-decimal precision.

decision.next_step: Continue the sealed first block to 750 unique officially aligned terminal conditions and score exactly once with measurement-v7. If two disjoint blocks pass, use the same v7 causal execution contract for exact measured-latency replay.
